It adds advanced-focus support to selected widgets, enables `release/v2` publishing, changes navigation flows, and updates integration and E2E tests. ### Changes **Board experience documentation** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Board editing guidance**
`apps/docs/docs/advanced/keyboard-shortcuts/index.mdx`, `apps/docs/docs/getting-started/after-the-installation.mdx`|Documents current keyboard, touch, resizing, movement, cancellation, responsive-layout, and save behavior.| |**Responsive board management**
`apps/docs/docs/management/boards/index.mdx`|Documents responsive layouts, rail constraints, layout repair, edit mode, duplication, permissions, and home-board fallback rules.| |**Shared interaction guidance**
`apps/docs/docs/advanced/styling/index.mdx`, `apps/docs/src/components/widgets/interactions.tsx`|Updates Custom CSS instructions and shared advanced-view and data-status guidance.| **Custom widget documentation** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Custom widget authoring flow**
`apps/docs/docs/management/custom-widgets/agent-authoring.mdx`, `apps/docs/docs/management/custom-widgets/authoring.mdx`, `apps/docs/docs/management/custom-widgets/index.mdx`|Documents workbench behavior, preview validation, data inspection, request journals, permissions, and preview-based creation.| |**Custom widget runtime rules**
`apps/docs/docs/management/custom-widgets/custom-jsx.mdx`|Documents manifest limits, sanitization, regex restrictions, `SubFetch`, actions, and `RefreshButton` behavior.| |**Custom widget security and diagnostics**
`apps/docs/docs/management/custom-widgets/requests-and-security.mdx`, `apps/docs/docs/management/custom-widgets/troubleshooting.mdx`, `apps/docs/docs/management/api/index.mdx`, `apps/docs/docs/management/mcp.mdx`|Documents request validation, executor limits, cache behavior, partial failures, diagnostics, and the AI / MCP tab.| **Widget advanced-view documentation** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Advanced-focus capability definitions**
`packages/widgets/src/*`|Selected widget definitions now declare advanced-focus support. Tests cover enabled and non-enhanced definitions.| |**Widget-specific interaction guidance**
`apps/docs/docs/widgets/*`|Updates advanced-view, permission, status, screenshot, and integration-specific documentation across widgets.| |**Downloads widget documentation**
`apps/docs/docs/widgets/downloads/index.mdx`, `apps/docs/docs/widgets/downloads/index.ts`|Documents layout thresholds, sorting, filters, statistics, permissions, queues, and integration behavior.| **Release and validation** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Release branch publishing**
`.github/workflows/workshop.yml`|The workflow publishes `release/v2` pushes and applies the `v2` Docker tag.| |**Synchronous navigation flows**
`apps/nextjs/src/app/[locale]/boards/(content)/_header-actions.tsx`, `apps/nextjs/src/app/[locale]/manage/custom-widgets/_use-custom-widget-form-actions.ts`|Board edit mode opens synchronously. Custom-widget creation navigates to the returned management path after resetting form state.| |**Automated flow validation**
`apps/workshop/tests/workshop.integration.mjs`, `e2e/custom-widgets-custom-jsx-v2.spec.ts`, `e2e/onboarding.spec.ts`|Tests validate quota integrity and update selectors and navigation waits for current UI flows.|

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
